notes: No official form is drafted or blocked for either track. Neither track names an official form; both record officialFormId null on every component, and whether the Coalition for Court Access publishes a statewide form for either mechanism is an open release blocker.

Both tracks leave verificationStatute.citation null with a flag, following the ND config's handling of its missing verification statute. Notarization is 'none' on both and no oath is stated for either.

The two tracks diverge on service, and deliberately: the collateral-action track's service rule is unconfirmed ("Confirm local practice before assuming the participant need not serve"), so no certificate of service is drafted; the supplemental-petition track's service rule is stated ("ordinary Trial Rules service on the prosecuting attorney") and corroborated twice in the compiled profile, so a certificate is included.

The supplemental petition is drafted as a container with two deliberately empty slots - the amendment relied on and the relief sought. It is not releasable until counsel settles the cycle's amendment.

Both tracks carry the same registry data defect: packetSet.components[2] is an attachment marked outputStrategy 'custom_pleading' when the only attachment either track records is a participant-obtained certified expungement order. Flagged on both, drafted on neither.

AUDIT NOTE (added by C1 audit pass, not by the data build): each track directory also contains a rendered/ subdirectory (canonical.txt, canonical.pdf, render-report.json) produced by a later renderer pass against the canonical fixture. Those rendered files are NOT clean and are not covered by the counsel flags above. Both rendered canonical.txt files carry Pennsylvania renderer-default prose that contradicts these configs - a jurisdiction/venue paragraph naming "the Court of Common Pleas of [COUNTY TO BE CONFIRMED] County, Pennsylvania", and a proposed-order custodian direction naming "The Pennsylvania State Police, [COUNTY TO BE CONFIRMED] County Court of Common Pleas" - even though both configs record recordCustodianLead null and assert no custodian direction. They also emit the literal string "null" where sovereignRole, verificationVerb and the eligibility basis are null, leave the {courtName}/{county}/{causeNumber} caption tokens unsubstituted, and (in in_supplemental_order) produce the ungrammatical clause "directed to grant relief consistent with the amendment all records relating to this matter". Both render-report.json files nevertheless report placeholderScan "clean". The defect originates in the shared renderer's PA_DEFAULT_PRESENTATION and its hard-coded jurisdiction/venue/custodian sentences (src/lib/record-clearing/renderers/custom-pleading-renderer.ts), which this data lane must not modify. Do not treat rendered/ as reviewable output until the renderer is jurisdiction-parameterised.
